q-syn.label: Closest in meaning
q-syn.summary: One capitalised word; pick the option closest in meaning.

q-ant.label: Opposite in meaning
q-ant.summary: One capitalised word; pick the option opposite in meaning.

rules.text: A word is positive, negative or neutral in tone. Its synonyms share the tone, so options of the opposite tone can be dropped at once.
rules.bad: BENEVOLENT: malicious (negative) cannot be a synonym.

rules.text: In an antonym question the word's synonym is almost always one of the options as a trap. Find the meaning first, then choose the opposite, not the same.
rules.bad: SCARCE: rare means the same, so it is the trap.

rules.text: Use the word's root or prefix when you do not know it: a-, in-, un-, non- usually negate; bene- is good, mal- is bad; poly- is many; anti- is against.
rules.ok: POLYMATHIC: poly (many) + math (learning), so wide learning.
rules.bad: Assuming 'poly' means 'one' and reading POLYMATHIC as narrow.

q-syn.cue: 'Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word' with one capitalised word.
q-syn.standard: Recall the meaning, then pick the option that could replace the word in a sentence without changing it.
q-syn.fast: Decide positive or negative first, drop options of the other tone, then choose among the rest.
q-syn.eliminate: An antonym is usually among the options, so drop the option that opposes the word before comparing the others.
traps: The antonym is almost always listed.
A word that merely fits the same topic is not a synonym.
In recent papers the word is often rare (abjure, amorphous, duplicitous): use root and tone when you do not know it.

q-ant.cue: 'Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word' with one capitalised word.
q-ant.standard: Recall the meaning, then pick the option that says the reverse.
q-ant.fast: Spot and ignore the synonym trap, then pick the option of the opposite tone.
q-ant.eliminate: Cross out every option that is close in meaning to the word. What remains contains the answer.
traps: The synonym is nearly always listed as bait, sometimes two or three of them.
An unrelated word is not an antonym: the answer must reverse the meaning.

pyqs.text:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

b.note: Faithful means true to a person or promise, the reverse of deceptive.

d.note: Loyal means firm in support, again the reverse of duplicitous.

pyqs.trick: Duplicity = double dealing. Negative word, so only the negative option (deceitful) survives.

pyqs.text:

d.note: Treacherous is a synonym here: disloyal and deceptive.

pyqs.trick: Three negatives and one positive: the single positive word is the antonym.
